title: $180M modification P00002 with a $280M cumulative face value
why: Three dollar figures are in play and only one of them is the value of this action. Recording the cumulative face value as the amount, or the modification as a new award, inflates the contractor's apparent new business by $100M and double-counts the base contract.
verified_against: the announcement prose, by hand. Not verified against any model output -- cache/llm/ is empty.

checks.quote: South Carolina Commission for the Blind, Columbia, South Carolina, was awarded a $180,000,000 modification (P00002) to contract W9124C-25-D-A003 for full food services
checks.reason: One paragraph, one company, one action -> exactly one row.

select.contractor_raw: South Carolina Commission for the Blind

checks.quote: was awarded a $180,000,000 modification (P00002) to contract W9124C-25-D-A003 ... The amount of this action is $180,000,000 with a total cumulative face value of $280,000,000. One bid was solicited with one received.
checks.reason: amount_usd is the amount of THIS action ($180,000,000), stated explicitly. The $280,000,000 is the cumulative total AFTER the action and belongs in cumulative_face_value_usd. 'One bid was solicited with one received' states both counts, unlike the pool case. No asterisk on the name -> small_business false, not null.
